description: This file defines the interface for EicProvisioning, a component related to Android's hardware identity provisioning. It includes structure definitions, function prototypes for initializing, creating keys, starting personalization, adding access control profiles and entries, and finalizing provisioning processes. The file also contains macro definitions and external dependencies, serving as a key part of the provisioning process in the hardware identity module.

classes.name: EicProvisioning
classes.description: Structure holding the state and configuration for the provisioning process, including cryptographic keys, counters, and flags.

methods.name: eicProvisioningInit
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning context for a new credential, setting up necessary cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: eicProvisioningInitForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares the provisioning context for updating an existing credential, including document type and encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: eicProvisioningCreateCredentialKey
methods.description: Generates a credential key pair and associated certificate, using a challenge and application ID.

methods.name: eicProvisioningStartPersonalization
methods.description: Begins the personalization process, setting up access control profiles and expected proof size.

methods.name: eicProvisioningAddAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile with specified parameters, including reader certificate and user authentication requirements.

methods.name: eicProvisioningBeginAddEntry
methods.description: Starts adding an entry with specified namespace, name, size, and access control profiles.

methods.name: eicProvisioningAddEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an entry, encrypting content and producing an encrypted output.

methods.name: eicProvisioningFinishAddingEntries
methods.description: Finalizes the addition of entries, producing a signature over the data.

methods.name: eicProvisioningFinishGetCredentialData
methods.description: Completes the process to retrieve encrypted credential data, including storage key and private key.
